finding: The isolated KSU footnote locator “Ma'ani al-Qur'an (377)” cannot identify a page uniquely. IslamWeb's Ma'ani interface explicitly locates al-A'raf 7:32 at page 377 in part/volume 1, while the poem cited in the KSU footnote occurs in the Kawthar discussion in a later part of this multivolume work. A separate King Faisal University thesis cites the poem at vol. 3, p. 296 and reports ها أنت instead of هل أنت. This makes omission of the volume/edition in KSU materially ambiguous; it does not prove which edition or volume page 377 KSU intended.

source_anchors.locator: interface says part 1; printed/electronic text marks page 377 for 7:32
footnote 9 cites Ma'ani 3/296 and reports variant ها أنت instead of هل أنت
note 8 gives bare citation Ma'ani al-Qur'an (377), quotes هل أنت

interpretation: Do not treat the bare (377) as a verified exact edition/page. Preserve competing quotations with named witnesses and keep T16B held until volume/edition is established and primary text is collated.
